Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme Health is interested in Redwood for inference of de-identified clinical notes in a pilot. Our security team completed the attached SIG Excel (section 1-5 filled with high-level asks) and flagged a few items we need clarified before procurement will proceed:

- GDPR / cross-border transfer posture: do you use SCCs or other transfer mechanisms?
- DPA: we need a draft to share with our legal team (can you provide your baseline DPA?)
- HIPAA / BAA feasibility: the pilot will process de-identified PHI, but we need to know whether Redwood will sign a BAA or offer a BAA-capable deployment option.
- SOC 2: can you confirm date of most recent report and whether it’s shared under NDA?

I attached the SIG spreadsheet with our specific controls highlighted. Please let me know who at Redwood will complete the SIG and if you can supply the SOC 2 and DPA drafts. Happy to set a quick call if easier.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire + DPA questions for Redwood

Marissa / Evelyn — draft answers and evidence pointers below (happy to iterate):

SOC 2:
- Most recent SOC 2 Type II report: audit period ended 2025-10-31. We can share the full report under NDA; suggest we provide a redacted copy for initial review and full report once NDA executed.

SIG completion status (high level):
- Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability sections: Controls implemented; mapped to SOC 2 and internal docs.
- Access control: RBAC in Console; support for SSO (SAML/OIDC) on Dedicated and Private.
- Encryption: TLS in transit, at-rest encryption with customer-specific KMS when on Dedicated/Private; hosted API uses managed KMS.
- Incident response: IR runbook, 24x7 pager for Dedicated accounts (SLA).

GDPR / Transfers / DPA / SCCs:
- Transfers: For hosted customers we rely on our DPA and implement lawful transfer mechanisms per customer need. For customers requiring SCCs, we can execute SCCs as part of the DPA; controller-to-processor and processor-to-processor wording available.
- Data residency: Private deployment and Dedicated allow customer-controlled regions; hosted API currently in US and EU regions — we can route per customer request where available.
- DPA: attached baseline DPA draft.

HIPAA / BAA feasibility:
- Short answer: Redwood can support HIPAA workloads via Redwood Private or Dedicated deployments where the customer controls environment and keys; for hosted multi-tenant API we generally do not sign a standard BAA by default.
- Requirements for BAA-capable offer: Dedicated or Private deployment, customer-provided compliance checklist, controls verification (we will supply evidence: SOC 2, encryption, access controls, audit logs). Additional commercial terms will be required (commitment level, support SLA).
- Suggested approach for Acme pilot: start with a scoped Dedicated node or Private evaluation in our US region to satisfy PHI handling requirements; legal can follow with a BAA addendum once environment is provisioned and we confirm controls.

Attachments (evidence links):
- redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf (redacted copy available pre-NDA; full copy after NDA)
- DPA-draft-Redwood-v1.docx
- HIPAA-feasibility-note-20260203.pdf (short one-pager on deployment options)

Next steps I suggest: Marissa sends a short summary to Acme and proposes a 30-minute call to walk through the SIG highlights and BAA path. If they want an executed NDA before the SOC 2, let me know and I’ll get the redaction ready.

— Dev
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Hi Laura — thanks for sending the SIG. We've reviewed internally and attached our completed SIG worksheet along with a redacted SOC 2, a baseline DPA, and a short HIPAA feasibility note that explains options for a BAA-capable deployment. High-level summary:

- SOC 2: redacted report attached (audit period through 2025-10-31). Full report available under NDA.
- DPA / SCCs: draft DPA attached; we can include SCCs as addendum where required.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood does not generally sign a BAA for the hosted multi-tenant API, but we can support a BAA on Dedicated or Private deployments where you control tenancy and keys. For the upcoming pilot (de-identified notes) we recommend using a scoped Dedicated environment to meet procurement/legal requirements and to make a BAA feasible.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review attached SIG answers and evidence.
2) If you want the full SOC 2, please share an NDA and we'll provide it.
3) Schedule a 30-minute call this week with Dev and Evelyn to walk through HIPAA path and DPA changes — proposed times: Wed 02/04 09:00-11:00 ET or Thu 02/05 14:00-16:00 ET.

Happy to adjust.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
